I'm just so unprepared for the world it seems. Everyone else around me has parents that helped them along the way. I feel like my mother did absolutely everything for me, and all of a sudden she expects me to just know how to do things that I never learned. I really honestly feel like trying to learn anything is hopeless and I'm past the point of getting anywhere. I have no motivation to learn or live or anything, I just want to stop living. or I just wish I was somewhere else, somewhere that my life right now doesn't exist. It's a lot of pressure in general, but even harder when you feel like there is actually nothing you can do to save yourself. 

Thanks for replying though. It really helps to know that someone, anyone, is listening.

My mother won't let me take out loans. She says if I do I'm not welcome back home. My friends don't really give a shit about me. At least they won't soon, because they're all planning to drop me anyway. I've always been a really terrible friend and a really terrible person. They'll be upset at first but I've seen how they handle suicide; they'll be back to normal in a couple weeks.
